title: Specified integral geometric comparison diagram and its component data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the completed coefficient categories, coefficient towers, and normalized reduction/limit adjunctions of [def-pur-conventions, det-sp-normalized-equivalence, det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. For a scheme map, PreservesKInjectives means preservation of K-injective complexes by the actual completed-module inverse image and its fixed-ring strict-tower inverse image. PullLimit is the natural pullback/total-limit isomorphism with its reconstruction-unit equation. SourceModel fixes the completed pullback/tensor/even-shift comparison on entire strict systems by its native reduction counit and cofinal tensor comparisons; towerSource is that ordered strict word. CoefficientTransport specifies the completed coefficient map, scalar-restriction compact-support comparison, ordinary pullback comparison, and their quotient/unit normalizations [def-sfb-integral-completed-coefficient-transport, def-pur-compact-support-transport]. For a Cartesian square with compactification, towerTate uses the canonical roots-of-unity line maps of [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists], and towerTateWord is their ordered pullback/tensor/shift composite. CompletedExchange fixes the compact-support comparison to the actual completed exchange [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map] for every generating tuple of the adic ideal. TateComparison consists of the source models, reconstruction unit, natural strict Tate word, and its entire-reduction identity. SmoothRealization is the existing integral adjunction realization of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection], retaining the compactification equality and level data; SmoothGammaRealization and its primed version assert equality with its actual limit-of-purity word followed by the counit-preserving comparison of right adjoints. Diagram packages these data, the specified image comparison, adjoint uniqueness, realized unit equations, completed support exchange, and the exceptional comparison with its reconstruction, total-limit and transpose equations. Result specializes existence of Diagram to the geometric Frobenius square [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius], using its isomorphism and prime-invertibility certificates. All these are the previous public definitions with unchanged names, signatures and bodies. SmoothPart contains only the two smooth realizations, their reconstruction identities, and the two unit-reduction equations; ReindexingPart contains only the two PullLimit data, the completed-reindexing predicates, and varying-ring K-injectivity; PurityPart, relative to SmoothPart, contains only TateComparison and the two normalized purity isomorphisms. These three structures are literal subsets of Diagram and assert no existence result.
